title: India's Junior Squad Prepares for BWF World Championships in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for nurturing India's next generation of badminton stars for a global junior event.
summary: The national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Centre of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing India's top junior talent for the upcoming global competition.

title: BAI Hosts Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course aims to enhance the skill level of Indian badminton coaches, directly impacting player development nationwide.
summary: The Badminton Association of India conducted a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Centre of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, focusing on elevating coaching standards.

title: New Regulations Issued for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: These regulations govern one of India's premier domestic team competitions, showcasing talent from across states.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the official regulations for the Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and procedures for the national tournament.

title: Women’s Doubles Pair Change for Junior World Championship Trials
indian_angle: This change directly impacts the composition and selection process for India's women's doubles contingent at the upcoming World Junior Championships.
summary: An important notification was issued regarding a change in the women's doubles pair participating in the selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp is vital for preparing India's young talent to compete against the best in Asia in the U17 and U15 categories.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change will impact how junior badminton is played and developed across India's domestic circuit.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
